objective: Load only the NUTS references needed for a cross-domain analogy task.
scenario: The user has an approved problem brief and asks Peanuts to explore biological and historical mechanisms for a potential solution.

input.request: Explore useful nature and historical analogies for this problem.

expected_behaviors: Load NUTS method and source-domain playbook.
Read the approved problem brief and only relevant linked source records.
Avoid loading unrelated event and user-interview references unless a clear dependency arises.
prohibited_behaviors: Load every Peanuts reference by default.
Generate analogies without understanding the target function.
